trailhead.label: The car park of the Museo Etnografico della Valvestino at Cima Rest, Magasa, the published start

cautions: Summer pastures with cows around the malghe: keep your dog on a lead and give the herds room.
Open pastures with almost no shade: on a hot day go early and bring water.
The first stretch at Cima Rest is on a small asphalt road with some cars: keep your dog close there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
